reviews.title: offers nothing
reviews.text:
yet another app that you download that has ZERO FUNCTIONALITY unless you pay. So its not a freemium app. It’s a fake paid app. 

this means if you pay for it for months and months then stop paying, you dont have anything. you cant go in and export because that needs a subscription. 

if the app dev is lying about the cost of the app, can you trust them with your photo data?
